K2 får inte heller användas av ett föret: K2 may also not be used by a company with a material deferred tax liability (the carrying amount of assets is higher than their tax base, or that of provisions or liabilities lower), or with one or more buildings that generate at least 75 per cent of net turnover. Punkt 1.1B gäller inte ett företag som u: Point 1.1B does not apply to a company that meets at most one of these conditions, each in each of the two latest fiscal years: more than 3 employees on average, a balance sheet total above 1.5 million kronor, net turnover above 3 million kronor. Punkterna 1.1A–1.1C har sin nuvarande ly: Points 1.1A–1.1C have their current wording from BFNAR 2025:2, which applies for the first time to fiscal years beginning after 31 December 2025. A company that started after 30 June 2025 with an extended first fiscal year ending on 31 December 2026 or later follows them already in that year.
Punkt 1.1B gäller inte om högst ett av f: Point 1.1B does not apply if at most one of the following holds in each of the two latest fiscal years: more than 3 employees on average, a reported balance sheet total above 1.5 million kronor, reported net turnover above 3 million kronor. Nor does it apply to a company that already applied K2 in the previous fiscal year and is not normally covered by point 1.1B; normally means more than one or a few isolated years (point 1.1C with commentary).
Punkterna 1.1A–1.1C i den här lydelsen k: Points 1.1A–1.1C in this wording come from BFNAR 2025:2 and apply to fiscal years beginning after 31 December 2025. Varje rätt med portionskostnad, pris och: Every dish with portion cost, price and margin, and what the till has sold during the period.

Mat som gästerna lämnat. Den är redan så: Food the guests left. It is already sold, so nothing is drawn from stock; the weight is saved as a measurement.

Registrera det som slängs här eller med: Record what is thrown away here or from your phone. The waste is then shown in the variance report, sorted by reason.

Avvikelsen räknas mellan två slutförda i: The variance is calculated between two completed stock counts of the same stock location, for example every Monday. Count under Stock → Stock count or with your phone.
Inga varor finns i båda inventeringarna: No goods are in both stock counts
Avvikelsen räknas för varor som är inven: The variance is calculated for goods counted at both the start and the end.

The value is calculated with the stock value per unit at the last stock count. A positive variance is consumption that is not explained.
Rätterna hade inget recept den dagen de: The dishes had no recipe on the day they were sold. Their raw materials are not included in what was sold, and NONOX does not guess them.
Svinnet är daterat i perioden men regist: The waste is dated within the period but was recorded after the stock count was completed, so the stock count had already removed the goods.
Försäljningen skulle ha dragit mer än la: The sale would have drawn more than the stock holds. The row is tried again every night. Draw it now that the stock has been corrected, or leave it for the next stock count.
Dra ingrediensen från lagret nu?: Draw the ingredient from stock now?
Lämna raden till nästa inventering? Den: Leave the row for the next stock count? It is not drawn from stock.

Dra råvarorna från lagret när kassan säl: Draw the raw materials from stock when the till sells the dishes

Applies to sales from the day the setting is switched on. Requires good recipes; without it, the stock count follows consumption and the variance report works anyway.
Bara den som får ändra lagrets inställni: Only someone who may change the stock settings can switch this on.

Registrera personalmat ovan, så sammanst: Record staff meals above, and the basis is compiled here.
Personalmaten för :period blir föreslagn: The staff meals for :period become proposed rows per employee. They are added to payroll only when you approve them in the month's payroll run. Föreslå kostförmånerna för :period? Rade: Propose the meal benefits for :period? Rows that are already proposed are replaced; approved rows are not changed.

There is no payroll run for :period. Create it under Payroll first.

Registrera personalmat, representation o: Record staff meals, entertainment (representation) and the owner's meals here.

Fritext för köket, åtskilda med komma. N: Free text for the kitchen, separated by commas. NONOX gives no allergen information to guests.

Köksanteckning, ingen allergeninformatio: Kitchen note, no allergen information to guests.

Kökets lagerställe, målet för råvarukost: The kitchen's stock location, the food cost target, the average cost of staff meals and whether sales should be drawn from stock.
Gäller hela företaget. Att slå på eller: Applies to the whole company. The owner switches Kitchen on or off under Modules.
Måltider till personalen, vid representa: Meals for staff, for entertainment (representation) and for the owner. The raw materials are drawn from stock as own use; no voucher and no VAT are booked.
Ingredienser med nettomängd och svinn. B: Ingredients with net quantity and waste. The gross quantity is what is taken from stock.
Rätter och grundrecept med ingredienser,: Dishes and base recipes with ingredients, waste and yield. The cost is calculated from the stock value of the ingredients.
Styr kontona för lagervärdet vid bokslut: Controls the accounts for the stock value at year-end: raw materials (1410) or goods for resale (1460). Empty = the company default.

registrerad efter inventeringen, inte me: registered after the stock count, not in the totals

An acceptance of a quote is kept as long as the quote and the order must be kept.
Under Mina uppgifter kan du se och ladda: Under My details you can see and download what is kept about you, change your name and remove your login. You can also object to the processing, ask for rectification or restriction, and complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).

Fakturor och kreditfakturor från avtalen: Invoices and credit invoices from the agreements
Belopp utan moms. En kreditfaktura ändra: Amounts excluding VAT. A credit invoice does not change MRR; only a change of the agreement does.
Kunderna grupperas efter månaden då de f: Customers are grouped by the month of their first MRR. A customer who comes back stays in their first cohort.
Kohorterna visas när kunder har haft MRR: The cohorts are shown once customers have had MRR.
Kohortens MRR som andel av dess MRR den: The cohort's MRR as a share of its MRR in the first month, every month at the exchange rates of :month.
Andel av kohortens kunder som har MRR, m: Share of the cohort's customers with MRR, month by month after the start.
Det som inte kan räknas med i MRR, och v: What cannot be counted in MRR, and why. Nothing is left out silently.
Avtalsfakturering: varje rad, utan moms: Recurring invoicing: every row, excluding VAT and after discount, converted to one month.
Avtalsregistret i CRM, när CRM är påslag: The agreement register in CRM, when CRM is on: the agreement's value per month, quarter or year. An agreement billed by a recurring invoice is counted only there, so nothing is counted twice.
Engångsbelopp, fakturor utan avtal och k: One-off amounts, invoices without an agreement and credit invoices do not change MRR. A credit invoice that belongs to a change of the agreement shows through that change.
Det finns ingen kurs från Riksbanken för: There is no rate from Riksbanken for :currencies. Rows in those currencies are not counted until the rate exists.
Varje registrerat avtal har en kund och: Every recorded agreement has a customer and an amount that can be converted to one month.
Hur den återkommande intäkten från avtal: How the recurring revenue from agreements and recurring invoicing moves: new customers, expansions, contractions and customers who leave.
Siffrorna räknas fram ur avtalsfaktureri: The figures are computed from recurring invoicing and, if CRM is on, the agreement register. Add an agreement and it shows here within a minute.
Öppen månad, räknas om vid varje ändring: Open month, recomputed at every change
med MRR vid månadens slut: with MRR at the end of the month
Negativ churn: utökningarna är större än: Negative churn: expansions exceed the losses
Kunderna för 12 månader sedan, deras MRR: The customers of 12 months ago, their MRR now
Paus, återaktivering, nya kunder, valuta: Pauses, reactivations, new customers, currency effects and corrections are not counted in churn. NRR and GRR use the month's exchange rates for both years, so changes in rates do not count as retained revenue.
Från förra månadens MRR till denna: From last month's MRR to this month's
Varje rad öppnar kunderna bakom beloppet: Every row opens the customers behind the amount. The rows add up to the öre.
MRR vid månadens slut: MRR at the end of the month
Rättelse är det som blev känt efter att: A correction is what became known after last month was closed. The closed month is unchanged.
Stängda månader visas som de ser ut i da: Closed months are shown as they look today, with the corrections that came afterwards. The stored months do not change.
Stängda månader visas som de rapporterad: Closed months are shown as reported when they were closed.
Månaderna räknas fram när det finns ett: The months are computed once there is an agreement or a recurring invoice.
MRR per kund vid månadens slut, hur den: MRR per customer at the end of the month, how it changed during the month, cohort and the agreements it comes from.
Kunder med ett avtal eller en avtalsfakt: Customers with an agreement or a recurring invoice are shown here.
En öppen månad räknas om varje gång ett: An open month is recomputed every time an agreement changes. When you close a month its figures are frozen; what becomes known later and affects the month is booked as a correction in the next open month.
Månaden är slut och kan stängas. Påminne: The month has ended and can be closed. The reminder comes in My dates on day :day of the following month. Nothing closes by itself.
MRR :amount och alla rörelser fryses och: MRR :amount and every movement are frozen and cannot be changed again. A later change that affects the month is shown as a correction in the next open month.
De stängda månaderna har inte kontroller: The closed months have not been verified yet. The verification runs every night.
Senast kontrollerad :time: alla :count s: Last verified :time: all :count closed months can be recomputed from the agreement versions, to the öre.
Kontrollen :time hittade avvikelser i :m: The verification at :time found differences in :months. Contact support.
Månaderna räknas fram från den månad mod: The months are computed from the month the module was turned on.
Månader före :month finns bara som uppsk: Months before :month exist only as an estimate from issued recurring invoices. They are not closed and not corrected.
Kunderna bakom beloppet och avtalen bako: The customers behind the amount and the agreements behind each customer. The rows add up to the month's amount.
No customer moved this way this month.
Pausad längre än 12 månader: räknas nu s: Paused for more than 12 months: now counted as churn.
Skiljer sig från månadens belopp :amount: Differs from the month's amount :amount. Run a recompute or contact support.
Avtal som är uppsagda eller har ett slut: Agreements that are cancelled or have an end date but still run. The customer pays to the end of the period, so the revenue counts as churn only in the month the agreement has ended, not when notice was given.
Inget avtal som räknas har ett slutdatum: No counted agreement has an end date right now.
En stängd månad ändras aldrig. Får NONOX: A closed month never changes. If NONOX later learns something that affects a closed month, such as a price change with an earlier date, the difference is booked here as a correction in the first open month.
Ingenting har ändrats i en stängd månad: Nothing has changed in a closed month after it was closed.
Management metrics, not bookkeeping. MRR is the contracted recurring amount excluding VAT on the last day of the month, converted to one month.
Siffrorna är kompletta från :month, då m: The figures are complete from :month, when the module was turned on; earlier months are estimated from issued recurring invoices.
Faktureras med en avtalsfakturering, som: Billed by a recurring invoice, which is counted instead
Totalvärde utan både start- och slutdatu: Total value without both a start and an end date
Ramavtal utan bestämt belopp: Framework agreement without a set amount
Kontot är inte kopplat till en kund: The account is not linked to a customer
Inläst när modulen slogs på: Read in when the module was turned on
För Återkommande intäkter: från vilket d: For Recurring revenue: the date from which a change, pause or ending applies. Empty: today.
Gäller från kan vara högst tio år tillba: Effective from can be at most ten years back.
Gäller från kan vara högst två år framåt: Effective from can be at most two years ahead.
Riksbanken har ingen kurs för :currencie: Riksbanken has no rate for :currencies at the end of :month. The month can be closed once the rate exists.
Riksbanken has no rate for :currencies at the end of the month. The latest known rate is used until it exists, and the month cannot be closed before then.
Kundens avtalsrader blir tillsammans min: The customer's agreement rows add up to less than zero, for example a discount row larger than the price. The customer counts as 0 kr until the agreement is corrected.
CRM är avstängt, så avtalsregistret räkn: CRM is off, so the agreement register is not counted
{1} En sak i underlaget behöver granskas: {1} One thing in the source data needs a review.|[2,*] :count things in the source data need a review.
Avtalen är markerade som separata och vi: The agreements are marked as separate and are no longer shown as possible double counting.
Du har inte behörighet att ändra underla: You are not allowed to change the source data for recurring revenue.
Kunden har både ett avtal i avtalsregist: The customer has both an agreement in the agreement register and a recurring invoice that are not linked to each other. If they are the same thing, the revenue is counted twice. Link the agreement in the register to the recurring invoice, and it is counted only there. If they are different agreements, mark them as separate. NONOX does not guess.
MRR vid månadens slut = ingående MRR + r: MRR at the end of the month = opening MRR + correction + currency effect ± source off or on + new + reactivated + resumed + expansions − contractions − pauses − churn. Every amount opens the customers behind it.
